human_confirmation: signed-in Cloud review of each paid stage
capacity_observations: unavailable until a supported observation source exists
notebook_execution: analysis-only local replay; no service attestation
scientific_study: scientific-study.v1: saved question, exact execution bindings, local analysis and portable notebook

client_presentation.fallback: readable scientific text and bounded numeric tables
client_presentation.figure_labels: input-order geometry labels with exact colocation; native result identities and small-selection magnitude values; no interpolation or rescaling

notebook_recovery.matches: study, project, plan revision, run, input/result fingerprints and exact frequency selection
notebook_recovery.unbound_or_different_context: recoverable through workspace artifacts; not current-study evidence

workspace_navigation.cloud_ownership: confirmed by subsequent scoped plan reads

saved_plans.pagination: reuse only the same project's returned cursor

workspace_navigation.notebooks: latest generated bundle and recorded context; use reproduce for exact selected-study matching; saved-byte checks do not verify the current environment
